detail: Improve access and attainment for students eligible for free school meals or from areas with the highest indicators of deprivation.
Improve access for young Black undergraduate students and attainment for Black and Asian students.
Improve access rates for care-experienced students.
Use clear and accessible information through the website, Open Days, online sessions, and outreach activities, particularly in Greater Manchester.
Manchester uses UCAS form information, including area disadvantage or low HE progression, school performance, care experience, and refugee status.
WP Plus and WP Plus PLUS applicants may receive reduced offers subject to eligibility and course requirements.
Eligible applicants can receive bus, train, or coach travel support for assessment-related campus visits.
